rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a very poor-quality early blastocyst/1DD, with appropriate concern about absent/degenerative ICM and TE, but it likely over-interprets image details and introduces uncertain features (e.g., debris, polar body, granular degeneration, exact cavity proportion) not clearly verifiable from a single image.

Thoroughly integrates age, prior live birth, tubal factor, endometrium, AMH, semen parameters, BMI, and lifestyle with the embryo grade, and appropriately emphasizes that favorable maternal factors cannot fully overcome severely poor embryo morphology.

The reasoning is structured and mostly logical, with the prognosis tied to embryo quality while acknowledging favorable patient factors. Minor issues include some speculative inferences about cohort attrition, protocol effect, and DOR/oocyte quality from limited data.

Core interpretation of Gardner 1DD and emphasis on poor prognosis are aligned with IVF practice, but several recommendations go beyond guideline-based evidence or are weakly supported (routine estradiol addition, GH/DHEA/CoQ10 suggestions, broad POI genetic workup, and relatively liberal PGT-A discussion in a young low-yield patient).

Provides clear next steps for current transfer counseling, luteal support, beta-hCG follow-up, and future cycle review, protocol reconsideration, and embryology workup. Some recommendations are more speculative than standard, preventing a top score.
